title: Vehicle Repair Authorization Form
subtitle: General Vehicle Repair: bounds the decision, conditions, and expiry.
description: Vehicle Repair Authorization Form turns vehicle system, reported symptom, diagnostic result, repair operation, part, and roadworthiness decision into a customer-facing General Vehicle Repair consent record. The service advisor itemizes diagnostics or services, labor, parts or materials, fees, tax, estimated total, maximum cap, and the customer / vehicle owner's signed decision. Work not listed or priced remains on hold.
use_case: Use Vehicle Repair Authorization Form at repair facility, service bay, test area, and customer handoff point. Verify applicable General Vehicle Repair requirements; distinguish diagnostic or inspection authority from listed work, price each operation, and record the customer / vehicle owner's exact approval, conditions, or decline. Follow the selected contact-before-additional-work instruction whenever vehicle system, reported symptom, diagnostic result, repair operation, part, and roadworthiness decision scope or cost changes.
